example_sentences_in_bangla: তার এখনো অক্ষরজ্ঞান হয়নি, সে খেলতে ব্যস্ত।
শিশুটির অক্ষরপরিচয় হলে স্কুলে ভর্তি করব।
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't even have basic literacy yet; he's busy playing.
We'll enroll the child in school once he learns his letters.
history: Refers to traditional Bengali education where children learn the alphabet using a writing stick (খড়ি) on a slate, common in rural settings before modern schooling.
note: The idiom evokes early childhood education in Bengali culture, often linked to the phrase 'হাতে খড়ি' indicating pre-literacy stage.
